items.title: Connect Agentic Pipelines to the redesigned Atlassian MCP
items.summary: Agentic Pipelines now integrate with the redesigned Atlassian MCP server for Claude and Codex agents. Rovo Dev CLI agents in Agentic Pipelines currently use the original version of Atlassian MCP server and are unaffected by this update. What benefits does this bring to you? How it works Connect to Jira, Confluence, and other products Bitbucket […]The post Connect Agentic Pipelines to the redesigned Atlassian MCP appeared first on Inside Atlassian.
